P1 (500–503) and P2 (502) are too short and likely capture only onset; P3 (502–554) aligns with the sustained offset interior and matches onset_offsets of P2/P3. P4 (544–547) lies within the same platform and is redundant; P5 (555) coincides with the return edge but lacks sustained interior evidence. Only P3 represents a genuine temporary platform with persistent interior observations supporting a coherent offset-return pair across N/E/U. No independent permanent step is evident inside the interval.
